name: Charnoluzky de Bangongshi
original_name: 查尔诺卢斯基的办公室
source:
[i]The tempestuous revolution calls for a transformation of thought and literature. The forces of the new and the old are locked in an unprecedented tug‑of‑war. And you, dear [b]Comrade Charnolusky[/b]—you stand at the very centre of these writers, these ideas, this storm.[/i]

In the visual novel game [b]Charnolusky‘s Office[/b], players assume the role of [b]Charnolusky[/b], the People's Commissar for Education of the newly established regime—[b]Rurik Commune[/b]. Through conversations and interactions with a diverse array of [b]writers[/b] and [b]poets[/b], you will decide their fates and the very course of literature itself.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5094980]Steam[/url]]
